post.description:
Imports resources (customers, subscriptions, billets or carnês) through a CSV file. Processing is done asynchronously.

> **Asynchronous Processing:** This endpoint is processed asynchronously.

The Import is done asynchronously, that is, when receiving the request,
our API saves the request parameters and processes the import in the background.
After the import is processed, the records will be associated with your Account.
You receive in this request response the ID of the Import created and can consult it at any time.

## Webhook Events

When the request is made, an `import.created` event is triggered.
Our server then begins processing the import.
After processing is complete, the `import.processed` event is triggered.

interest_type.description:
Interest/penalty type:
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For daily percentage
* `2` For daily amount
* `7` For monthly percentage - Supported banks: Bradesco, BB, BTG, Caixa, Inter, Itaú, Safra, Santander, Sicoob and Sicredi

days_for_interest.description: Number of days after the due date when the penalty will start to accrue. The default value is 1 day (the day after the due date).

interest_percentage.description: Interest percentage. From 0.0 to 100.0 (Ex 1.5% = 1.5) Required if interest_type equals 1 or 7. Up to 2 decimal places.

interest_value.description: Daily interest amount (R$). Required if interest_type equals 2. Up to 2 decimal places.

interest_days_type.description:
Type of days for interest:
* `0` Calendar
* `1` Business

fine_type.description:
Fine type:
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For percentage of boleto amount
* `2` For fixed amount

days_for_fine.description: Number of days after the due date when the fine will start to accrue. The default value is 1 day (the day after the due date).

fine_percentage.description: Late fee percentage Ex: 2% x R$ 250.00 = R$ 5.00. Required if fine_type equals 1. Up to 2 decimal places.

fine_value.description: Fine amount (R$). Required if fine_type equals 2. Up to 2 decimal places.

discount_type.description:
Discount type:
The discount type will be the same for all three discounts, if they exist. :
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For fixed amount
* `2` For percentage of boleto amount

days_for_discount.description: Days for discount. Required if discount_type is different from 0 (zero)

discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the discount. Required if discount_type equals 2

discount_value.description: Discount amount (R$). Required if discount_type equals 1.

second_discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the second discount.

third_discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the third discount.

charge_type.description:

Calendar days for withdrawal/return:

                0: Withdrawal/Return on the same day as maturity.
                1 or more: Withdrawal/Return after maturity (Maturity + X calendar days).

credit_bureau.description:
Credit Bureau/Negative Registry Agency.

`0`: Serasa.
`1`: Quod.
`2`: SPC

Options available for each supported bank:

* Banco do Brasil: Serasa and Quod.

status.description:
Status of protest event:
* `order_issued` - Issuance of protest order
* `order_generated` - Generation of protest order
* `registry_sent` - Sent to notary
* `protested` - Protest completed
* `order_cancelled` - Cancellation of protest order
* `withdrawal_requested` - Request for withdrawal of registry
* `registry_withdrawn` - Withdrawal of registry (withdrawal from notary)
* `registry_withdrawal_dispatched` - Dispatch of withdrawal of registry
* `suspended` - Protest suspension
* `cancellation_requested` - Request for cancellation of protest
* `cancellation_released` - Release of cancellation
* `cancellation_sent` - Sending cancellation to notary
* `cancelled` - Protest cancelled

sue_code.description: Protest code (CNAB 240). Check the possible values for each bank.

revoke_code.description: Withdrawal code (CNAB 240). Check the possible values for each bank.

first_instruction.description: First instruction (CNAB 400). Check the possible values for each bank.

second_instruction.description: Second instruction (CNAB 400). Check the possible values for each bank.

payment_count.description: Number of partial payments accepted for this boleto.

divergent_payment_type.description:
Type of divergent payment:
Valid only for Itaú and Caixa.
* `1` Accepts any divergent amount
* `2` Accepts payments within a range of amounts or percentages
* `3` Does not accept divergent amount payments
* `4` Accepts payments above a minimum amount or percentage

divergent_payment_value_type.description:
Type of value to consider for payment limits:
Valid only for Itaú and Caixa.
* `1` Reports divergent payments by amounts
* `2` Reports divergent payments by percentages

divergent_payment_maximum_value.description: Maximum value for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_minimum_value.description: Minimum value for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_maximum_percentage.description: Maximum percentage for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_minimum_percentage.description: Minimum percentage for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_limit.description: Number of payments allowed. Required if divergent payment data is provided. Used only by Caixa.

prevent_registration.description:
Prevent sending registration to bank:

If `true`, prevents the boleto from being registered. To be used in cases where the boleto was already registered outside of Kobana but you want to include it in the system.

issued_at.description: Boleto issuance date. Accepted only when `prevent_registration: true`.

control_number.description:
Control number:

May contain any information of interest to the Company. The information contained in this field will always be returned with the respective title in the return file.

ignore_email.description: Do not send this boleto by email

ignore_sms.description: Never send this boleto by SMS

ignore_whatsapp.description: Never send this boleto by WhatsApp

custom_data.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format.

meta.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format.

custom_attachment_name.description: Name to be used in boleto files sent to the customer in notifications. Accepts use of variables. If left empty, the default is the word "boleto" followed by the ID.

split_payment.description:
Payment split.
Valid only for ABC Brasil, Bradesco and Itaú.
If true, the boleto split will be registered.
Provide the split accounts in `split_accounts`.
For Itaú, you must provide the type of payment split in `split_payment_type`

split_payment_type.description:
Type of payment split:
Valid only for Itau. Used only with Payment split true.
* `1` Credit split by percentage (%) – Nominal value of the title
* `2` Credit split in amount (R$) – Nominal value of the title
* `3` Credit split by percentage (%) – Net amount received
* `4` Credit split in amount (R$) – Net amount received, split proportionally

created_via_api.description: Indicates if the boleto was created by API

updated_at.description: Boleto last update date and time

registration_status.description:
Registration status at the bank:
* `pending` Pending
* `skipped` Skipped
* `requested` Requested
* `confirmed` Confirmed
* `rejected` Rejected (will be retried)
* `failed` Failed (will not be retried)

cancellation_reason.description:
Cancellation reason:
* `1` Other
* `2` Fraud
* `3` Death
* `4` Operational error
* `5` Settlement paid

prevent_pix.description: If true, prevents Pix creation for wallets with Pix enabled. It is not considered if the wallet does not have Pix enabled.

status.description:
Wallet status:
When the wallet has just been registered, it receives the status `pending`.

At this point the user must accept the terms and start the homologation.

When clicking on "Proceed with Homologation", the status changes to `homologating`.

A boleto and a Homologation remittance will be generated to be sent to the bank. After completion, the status changes to `validating`.

From this point on, the user needs to inform the value of the boleto that was generated or send the return processed by the bank.

When the value is correctly informed, or in the processed return, the bank says everything is correct, the status changes to `active`.

* `pending` Homologation not started
* `homologating` In homologation, awaiting boleto payment
* `validating` Boleto paid, awaiting validation
* `active` Active and ready to use

default.description:
Default.
The `default` field determines the collection wallet that will be used in the creation of the boleto when no wallet is provided.

When the first wallet is homologated (moves to `status` = `active`), it receives the value `default` = `true`

status.description:
Wallet status:
When the wallet has just been registered, it receives the status `pending`.

At this point the user must accept the terms and start the homologation.

When clicking on "Proceed with Homologation", the status changes to `homologating`.

A boleto and a Homologation remittance will be generated to be sent to the bank. After completion, the status changes to `validating`.

From this point on, the user needs to inform the value of the boleto that was generated or send the return processed by the bank.

When the value is correctly informed, or in the processed return, the bank says everything is correct, the status changes to `active`.

* `pending` Homologation not started
* `homologating` In homologation, awaiting boleto payment
* `validating` Boleto paid, awaiting validation
* `active` Active and ready to use

default.description:
Default.
The `default` field determines the collection wallet that will be used in the creation of the boleto when no wallet is provided.

When the first wallet is homologated (moves to `status` = `active`), it receives the value `default` = `true`

url.description: Address where requests will be made

events.description: Events that should generate notifications for the webhook. Choose one or more events.

active.description: Defines whether the webhook will be active, receiving notifications. The default value is `true`.

subaccounts.description: Defines whether the webhook will be active for subaccount events.

bank_billet_account_id.description: ID of the [Billing Account](/reference/post_v1-bank-billet-accounts). If provided, the webhook will only receive notifications for events related to the specified billing account.

auth_kind.description: Type of authentication configured. Returned in responses. To configure, send the `auth` object in the body.

auth.description: Authentication configuration of the receiving endpoint. For creation/update only — not returned in responses.

token.description: Token (for `bearer` only). Leave blank to keep the current token.

header_value.description: Header value (for `api_key` only). Leave blank to keep the current value.
